evals.prompt: Run PM Weekly over the complete frozen W35 Project Memory set.
evals.expected_output: Final Project reports roll into one Department report and one Company report.
assertions: Every report uses its template headings.
Rollups cite every immediate child report.

evals.prompt: Review a workflow observed once beside a repeated receiver-accepted workflow.
evals.expected_output: Only the repeated workflow updates SOP interval evidence; the one-off stays Project-only.
assertions: The update cites the repeated listing evidence.
The one-off collar workflow does not become a company SOP.

evals.prompt: Run PM Weekly with one expected active Project Memory file missing.
evals.expected_output: The affected Department and Company reports remain blocked and no long-term memory changes.
assertions: No Final Company report is written.
No memory or provider effect is attempted.
